authors.name: Naval Ravikant
quotes: The most important skill for getting rich is becoming a perpetual learner.
Read what you love until you love to read.
Happiness is a choice and a skill and you can dedicate yourself to learning that skill and making that choice.
If you want to be successful, surround yourself with people who are more successful than you are.
The purpose of life is to be happy.

authors.name: Charlie Munger
quotes: The best investment you can make is in yourself.
In my whole life, I have known no wise people who didn't read all the time.
The big money is not in the buying and selling, but in the waiting.
It is remarkable how much long-term advantage people like us have gotten by trying to be consistently not stupid, instead of trying to be very intelligent.

authors.name: Balaji Srinivasan
quotes: Knowledge is the new money. Information is the new wealth.
The internet is the greatest library ever created.
The future is already here – it's just not evenly distributed.
Code is law, and the internet is the new frontier.

authors.name: Alex Hormozi
quotes: Success is not about being the best. It's about being better than you were yesterday.
The more you learn, the more you earn.
Your network is your net worth.
The best time to start was yesterday. The second best time is now.
